name: usage-meter
description: A quiet usage line above the prompt that appears only when context, a plan window or a dollar limit needs a look, and an optional limit (plan-window used/total, or dollars for API-key use) that asks before the next prompt instead of refusing. Type /usage-meter for a short report.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Track usage, show the line and apply the limits. Off: the mod does nothing at all.

limitPct.title: Usage limit (% of plan window)
limitPct.description: 0 = no limit. When any plan window (5h / 7d) is at or above this many points out of 100, the next prompt you type asks once: continue (+10 points), continue without a limit, or hold it. Tool calls in a running turn are never stopped. /usage-meter 80 sets it for the current session only.

limitUsd.title: Spending limit (USD)
limitUsd.description: Spending limit in USD for this session; for API-key use, where no plan window is reported. 0 = no limit. /usage-meter $10 sets it for the current session only.

contextWarnPct.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarnPct.description: Show the usage line when the context window is at least this full.

showLine.title: Usage line
showLine.description: Show the quiet usage line above the prompt box (terminal and desktop). It stays hidden until something matters.

showPace.title: Usage pace
showPace.description: Mark a plan window (5h / 7d) that is on pace to run out before it resets with a ▲ in the usage line and the report. Never blocks anything.

showDailyCost.title: Daily cost
showDailyCost.description: Show "Today $x" (spend across sessions, kept locally for 60 days) in the usage line and the report.

showWeeklyCost.title: Weekly cost
showWeeklyCost.description: Show "Week $y" (spend since the weekly plan window opened) when the account reports a 7d window.
